## Objective
- Build a complete, polished, playable 3D fighting game in the existing project.

## Requirements
- Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions.
- Save small JPEG screenshots for checks, viewport no wider than 1280px, and read only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- Implemented a self-contained browser game in `index.html` using Three.js from a CDN, procedural fighters and arena, and keyboard/touch controls.

## Work State
### Completed
- Created a 3D arena fighting game with two fighters, HUD, rounds, AI opponent, attacks, guarding, movement, and responsive touch controls.
- Fixed a malformed CSS gradient after the first screenshot showed unstyled layout.
- JavaScript syntax check passed with `node --check`.

### Active
- Diagnose the browser console error `missing ) after argument list`; Three.js has not rendered, and the game remains unverified.

### Blocked
- Browser rendering is blocked by the unresolved console error; inspect module parsing/runtime to locate the source.

## Next Move
1. Inspect `index.html` module code and browser error details to resolve `missing ) after argument list`.
2. Reload the page, verify the arena and gameplay in-browser, and save/read the latest JPEG screenshot.
3. Report the implementation and any remaining assumptions or limitations.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Complete game implementation; current issue is browser console error during loading.
- `screenshots/initial.jpg`: First screenshot, captured before the CSS gradient fix; shows unstyled layout and no rendered arena.

## Important Context
- A Python HTTP server is running on port `3002`; browser URL is `http://localhost:3002`.
- `playwright-cli` is installed and Chromium was installed.
- Browser console currently reports exactly `missing ) after argument list`; the script passes `node --check`, and external font requests succeeded.
